A secondary warm glow pulses from the middle distance, reinforcing depth and leading the eye toward the seating area. The atmosphere is calm and refined — a sophisticated residential outdoor entertaining space captured in the transitional blue hour. The hardscaping is minimal and clean, with precise step edges and level changes lending geometric structure.
